hints.items_per_raid: Items received divided by the number of raid nights the player attended.
hints.gain: Gain frozen when the loot is imported: the one of the player's sim at that time (same item, same difficulty, main spec, sim before the drop), which a new sim no longer changes. Without a frozen gain (older drop, file import, no sim at import), gain estimated from the latest sim, the only one kept, if it predates the drop. Otherwise "unknown", and left out of the average.
hints.bis: Items of the current wishlist (main spec, all difficulties) obtained by the end of the period.

detail.gain_estimated: Estimated gain, none frozen at import — sim of {{date}}
